units.source_text: 我们相隔一块田地，站在田埂上观望。

en.t: We stood on the ridge between the rice fields, watching from across a field.

units.source_text: 围观的人越来越多，彼此肩并着肩，相对无言，连我们头上的月亮似乎也被挤压得变小了。

en.t: More and more onlookers gathered, shoulder to shoulder, facing one another in silence, and even the moon above our heads seemed to have been squeezed smaller.
